ingredientSections.heading: Warm Olives
items: A good pinch toasted ground coriander seeds
A good pinch toasted ground fennel seeds

methodSections.heading: Warm Olives
steps: Smash the garlic and remove the stems from the rosemary and thyme.
Strain the olives and then spread out on an oven dish or pan. Add the olive oil and crushed garlic.
Roast in the oven at 200°C (400°F) for 15-20 minutes.
Remove from the oven, add remaining ingredients and mix together.
Serve warm with a small splash of red wine vinegar.
